newsitem.title: USA: Pete's Brewing names Marineau chairman.
newsitem.headline: Pete's Brewing names Marineau chairman.

text.p: Pete's Brewing Co said it named director Philip Marineau chairman of the board of directors, a previously vacant position.
It also said Chief Financial Officer Jeffrey Atkins was named to the additional post of acting chief operating officer.
He will replace Mark F. Bozzini, who retires as president, chief executive officer and director, effective immediately.
Although he is retiring from his official titles, Bossini will remain with the company until February 28, working on 1997 marketing programs.
The company said it will promptly begin a search for a new chief executive.
